system.soothing_audio_desc: Allows species-appropriate calming audio when the AI considers the environment safe.
system.soothing_audio_mode_cat_desc: The cat preset uses brighter, higher-frequency tones with less background noise.
system.soothing_audio_mode_dog_desc: The dog preset uses a lower-tempo warm pad with soft background noise.
system.soothing_audio_mode_silent_desc: The silent preset plays no added audio; the goal is to keep the room quiet.
system.soothing_audio_manual_off: Soothing audio is turned off manually.
system.soothing_audio_silent_mode: Silent mode is selected; no added soothing audio is playing.
system.soothing_audio_ai_ready: Soothing audio can be used when AI deems it safe.
system.soothing_audio_ai_blocked: AI is temporarily blocking soothing audio for safety.
system.soothing_audio_playing: Soothing audio is currently playing at a low level.
system.soothing_audio_waiting_interaction: Tap the screen once to start soothing audio.
system.soothing_audio_unavailable: This browser does not support soothing audio.
system.update_desc: Downloads the latest software via GitHub.
system.update_warn: Warning: The update process may cause system restarts or temporary interruptions. Do you want to continue?
system.update_warn_text: The update process may cause system restarts or temporary interruptions.
system.update_reset_desc: Returns the system to the previous stable version.

system.install_deps_warn_text: Installation may take a few minutes; restart the service after it completes.
system.install_deps_confirm: Python dependencies will be installed or updated. This may take a few minutes. Continue?
system.install_deps_restart_confirm: Dependencies were installed. Restarting is recommended for changes to take effect. Restart now?

ai_vitals.title: Experimental Camera Vitals
ai_vitals.subtitle: Camera-derived respiration is secondary/experimental; primary monitoring is the life cycle.
ai_vitals.analysis_ok_text: Respiration is readable and most records are reliable.
ai_vitals.analysis_warning_text: Interpret the result carefully because confidence or motion load is affecting it.
ai_vitals.analysis_waiting_text: As AI readings arrive, respiration and confidence will appear here as a plain summary.
ai_vitals.action_ok: Keep watching latest respiration and the baseline band.
ai_vitals.action_motion: Interpret respiration carefully until movement settles.
ai_vitals.action_quality: Check camera framing, light, and patient visibility.
ai_vitals.action_wait: Wait a few minutes for records while AI is on.
ai_vitals.motion_chart_desc: Animal movement activity inside the cage
ai_vitals.status_chart_desc: Distribution and order of AI vital states
ai_vitals.recent_records_desc: Table view of the latest AI vital measurements
ai_vitals.no_data: No AI vital records were found for the selected range.

life_cycle.title: Kuvoz - Life Cycle
life_cycle.subtitle: Goal-based behavior tracking and abnormal situation checks
life_cycle.goal_waiting_title: Waiting for records to check goals
life_cycle.goal_waiting_text: Feeding/drinking, rest, and activity goals will be summarized here as behavior records arrive.
life_cycle.goal_ok_text: Records for {patient} look within the target range.
life_cycle.goal_warning_text: One behavior goal should be watched closely.
life_cycle.goal_critical_text: Patient behavior suggests a situation that needs a prompt check.
life_cycle.goal_action_wait: Collect the first behavior records with AI on or manual entry.
life_cycle.goal_action_review: Review the recommendation on the abnormal situation card.
life_cycle.goal_action_check_patient: Check the patient, food/water status, and general behavior.
life_cycle.goal_rest_waiting: A few more records are needed for rest balance.
life_cycle.goal_rest_low: No rest records; restlessness may be present.
life_cycle.goal_rest_high: Rest ratio is high; watch for lethargy.
life_cycle.anomaly_no_feeding_msg: No feeding or drinking behavior detected in the last 24 hours!
life_cycle.anomaly_no_feeding_rec: Consult a veterinarian immediately. Loss of appetite can be a sign of serious problems.
life_cycle.anomaly_low_feeding_msg: Only {count} feeding behaviors detected in the last 24 hours.
life_cycle.anomaly_low_feeding_rec: Check food and water freshness. Consult a veterinarian if the patient has no appetite.
life_cycle.anomaly_hyperactivity_msg: {count} high-intensity activity behaviors detected in the last 24 hours.
life_cycle.anomaly_hyperactivity_rec: The patient may be stressed or in pain. Provide a calming environment.
life_cycle.anomaly_excessive_rest_rec: The patient is sleeping more than normal. This may be a sign of lethargy, check it.
life_cycle.anomaly_no_rest_msg: No resting behavior detected in the last 24 hours.
life_cycle.anomaly_no_rest_rec: The patient is constantly moving. This may be a sign of pain or restlessness.
life_cycle.anomaly_high_intensity_rec: Behavior is abnormally intense. Consult a veterinarian.
life_cycle.anomaly_long_duration_rec: Behavior lasting longer than normal. Observe and take notes.
life_cycle.anomaly_motion_msg: The camera detected clear motion and is tracking it as an activity event.
life_cycle.anomaly_motion_rec: If motion persists, check patient comfort and possible pain or stress.
life_cycle.anomaly_low_confidence_rec: Check framing, lighting, and visible torso area.

remote.title: Tailscale Remote Access
remote.desc: Use Tailscale VPN for secure remote access
remote.not_installed_desc: You need to install Tailscale for remote access.
remote.what_is_desc: Tailscale is a VPN solution that securely connects your devices over a private network. You can safely access your Kuvoz device over the internet.
remote.install_confirm: Start Tailscale installation? This may take a few minutes.
remote.not_connected_desc: Click the button below to connect to the Tailscale network.
remote.change_network_confirm: The current Tailscale session will be logged out. On the next connection, you can sign in to a different network. Continue?
remote.change_network_done: Tailscale session ended. You can now connect to a different network.
remote.reset_identity_confirm: This will turn off Tailscale, log out, and delete this device's saved Tailscale identity. Use it for cloned devices with IP/identity conflicts. You must reconnect with Connect afterward. Continue?
remote.reset_identity_done: Tailscale identity reset. Use Connect to add the device back to the Tailscale network.
remote.reset_identity_disconnected: The connection was lost while resetting the Tailscale identity. This can be expected; use the local screen or a new connection to add the device back to the Tailscale network.
remote.key_expiry_desc: To avoid expired-device problems, key expiry should be disabled for this device on the Tailscale Machines page. If the device asks for authentication, create a new sign-in link with Reauth QR first.
remote.reauth_confirm: A Tailscale reauthentication link will be created. If you are using this over a remote connection, the connection may drop temporarily; use the local screen when possible. Continue?
remote.disable_key_expiry_confirm: The Tailscale Machines page will open. On this device row, choose Disable key expiry from the three-dot menu. Continue?
remote.disable_key_expiry_hint: Find this Kuvoz device on the Machines page, then choose Disable key expiry from the three-dot menu. The link was also copied to the clipboard.
remote.still_waiting: Still waiting... Please be a little more patient.
remote.disconnect_confirm: Are you sure you want to disconnect Tailscale?
remote.scan_desc: Scan the QR code below to log in to your Tailscale account:
remote.how_to_1: Scan the QR code with your mobile device camera
remote.how_to_2: Log in with your Tailscale account (or create one for free)
remote.how_to_3: Add your device to your network
remote.ip_desc: You can access Kuvoz remotely with these IP addresses:
remote.access_1: Open Tailscale app on your mobile device
remote.access_2: Connect to the same Tailscale network
remote.access_3: Go to one of the IP addresses above in your browser:
remote.access_4: You can access Kuvoz control panel!
remote.sharing_desc: You need to enable sharing permission to use the remote help feature. When enabled, other users on the Tailscale network can access your device.
remote.trust_only: Share only with people you trust!
remote.internet_warning: Warning: Your device is open to the internet!
remote.ssh_note: Important: Tailscale VPN must be active for SSH!
remote.sharing_item_1: Users on your Tailscale network can access this device
remote.sharing_item_2: Kuvoz control panel can be accessed remotely
remote.sharing_item_3: Sensor data and controls can be viewed
remote.when_use_1: If you are having a technical problem with your device
remote.when_use_2: If you are receiving help from authorized service personnel
remote.when_use_3: If you want to check the device with a trusted specialist
remote.tip_1: Turn on sharing only when needed
remote.tip_2: Always turn it off when you're done
remote.tip_3: Send the sharing link only to people you trust
remote.understand_confirm: I have read, understood and I confirm
remote.sharing_enabled_msg:
✅ Sharing permission granted!

Security: This permission is valid for 24 hours.
Click the "Close Sharing" button when you are done.
remote.sharing_disabled_confirm:
Are you sure you want to close the sharing permission?

Remote access will not be possible after this.
remote.sharing_disabled_msg:
✅ Sharing permission closed.
Your device is now safe.
remote.permission_denied:

remote.funnel_warning:

Anyone who knows this URL can access your device.
Share only with people you trust.

Continue?
remote.funnel_close_confirm: Are you sure you want to close public access?

{url}

Then try again.
remote.help_body_intro:
Hello,

I need remote help for my Kuvoz incubator device.
remote.participation_desc: Support personnel must join the Tailscale network to access this device:
remote.pc_step_2_desc: After installation, Tailscale icon will appear in system tray
remote.pc_step_3_desc: Log in with Google, Microsoft, GitHub, or email. Free account is sufficient (up to 100 devices)
remote.pc_step_4_title: 📧 Send the following info to support personnel:
remote.pc_step_4_desc: Your Tailscale email address and device name.
remote.pc_step_5_desc: You will receive an invite link via email. Click link to join network.
remote.pc_step_6_desc: Activate Tailscale VPN and open the Access URL.
remote.mobile_step_1_desc: Search for "Tailscale" in App Store or Play Store.
remote.mobile_step_2_desc: Log in with the same account.
remote.mobile_step_4_desc: Open the URL in mobile browser. Kuvoz interface will appear.
remote.note_1: Same Network: Support personnel must be on the same Tailscale network.
remote.note_2: Invite Required: Mutual invitation may be necessary.
remote.note_3: Internet Required: Both sides must have internet connection.
remote.note_4: VPN Active: VPN must be running on both sides.
remote.ts_item_1_2: Are you on the same network?
remote.ts_tip_expert: ✅ Tip: If support personnel is experienced, sharing only the IP may be enough.
remote.cert_note: 💡 Note: Browser may show certificate warning - continue with "Advanced" → "Proceed".
remote.ssh_ready_note: ⚠️ Important: Tailscale VPN must be active for SSH!
remote.email_recipient_hint: Leave blank to open your email app and enter the recipient there.
remote.share_by_phone_desc: Instead of typing an email on the kiosk screen, scan the QR code. Your phone opens the Tailscale sharing screen for this device.
remote.share_by_phone_hint: Sign in with your Tailscale admin account on the phone, then choose Share... from this device row menu.
remote.share_qr_step_1: Scan the QR code with your phone.
remote.share_qr_step_2: Sign in with your Tailscale admin account.
remote.share_qr_step_3: On the device row that opens, choose Share... from the three-dot menu.
remote.share_qr_step_4: Enter the email address in Tailscale and send the invite.
remote.share_qr_error: Could not create the sharing QR.
remote.tailnet_invite_title: 👥 Invite to the Same Tailscale Network
remote.tailnet_invite_desc: Enter the email address to add a user to the same Tailscale network. Kuvoz copies the address; on the kiosk screen, continuing by QR from a phone is the safest method.
remote.tailnet_invite_hint: This button does not send email by itself. On the Raspberry kiosk, external Tailscale pages are not opened; the actual invite email is sent only after you click "Invite" on the Tailscale Users page from a phone or PC.
remote.tailnet_invite_same_device_confirm: The Tailscale Users page will open in a new tab. You will send the invite email there with "Invite". Continue?
remote.tailnet_invite_qr_step_1: Scan the QR code with your phone.
remote.tailnet_invite_qr_step_2: Sign in on your phone with your Tailscale admin account.
remote.tailnet_invite_qr_step_3: Paste the email shown below into the Users page that opens.
remote.tailnet_invite_qr_step_4: Send the invitation using the Invite button in Tailscale.
remote.tailnet_invite_missing: Enter the email address to invite first.
remote.tailnet_invite_opened: ✅ Email copied. No email was sent automatically; paste it into the Tailscale Users page that opened and send it with "Invite".
remote.tailnet_invite_kiosk_blocked: The Tailscale Users page was not opened on the kiosk screen. Showing the QR screen; finish the invite from a phone.
remote.kiosk_external_blocked: Opening external pages is disabled on the kiosk screen. The link was copied; open it from a phone or computer, or scan the QR code.
remote.help_support_desc: Share the following information with the support team:
remote.admin_share_note: For real device sharing with multiple different Tailscale accounts, use the "Share..." screen in the Tailscale Admin Console. There you can add multiple email addresses or create a reusable invite link.
